reuse.why: Linking goes through the shared linkBankSyncAccount like every other provider, and the balance step reuses the Akahu branch, but the download is a fresh copy of downloadAkahuTransactions instead of a shared request helper.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near line-for-line copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (token, post, error mapping, response shaping), which grows the existing per-provider duplication.

placement.why: Each piece sits where its siblings live (link in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in sync.ts, URL in server-config, account type in types/models), but 'fintegra' is not added to SYNC_PROVIDERS in types/models/bank-sync.ts, the list that defines the sync sources.

scope.why: Server-side only, exactly the pieces the request lists, plus tests.

maintainability.why: It follows the established pattern so it is easy to read, but it adds another copy of the transaction download and another string branch in two if-chains, and leaves the provider registry out of step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The provider registry SYNC_PROVIDERS/BankSyncProviders in types/models/bank-sync.ts is not extended, so 'fintegra' is used as a sync source outside the declared provider list.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in server/accounts/sync.ts is a plain copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, renamed but not reshaped.
